## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List the checks you ran and their results. Include the OS, DAW, and Max version for host testing. State any checks you could not run.

For UI changes, add screenshots. For generation changes, explain the musical reasoning and include a small before/after example when useful.

## Before review

- [ ] This pull request focuses on one change and updates affected documentation.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute the submitted code and assets under the project's published license.
- [ ] I have removed credentials, private project data, and unnecessary generated/build files.
- [ ] If generation changed, I updated both engines and ran the parity checks, or explained why that is not applicable.
